proposed_rules.trigger: A recurring end-of-page zone (rc2) with a CTA heading ('The best no-code platform for...') and a link row rendered as bare pipe separators, appearing identically at the bottom of every page above the cookie overlay.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude entirely from per-page block inventory; model as a global footer fragment/site-wide chrome, analogous to the confirmed knack-announcement-bar rule.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical structure recurs unchanged on this and every other page examined; it is not page-specific content.

proposed_rules.trigger: 'Join ... users' heading immediately followed by a 5xN grid near the top of a solution page.
proposed_rules.decision: Emit as one 'trust-badges' block, one row per badge/item. Rejected alternative: modeling as a generic logo/card grid without a dedicated block name.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs with identical shape across multiple solution pages in this batch (C243, C244, C246, C247, C248); reinforces the already-proposed rulebook candidate.

proposed_rules.trigger: A section with a [bg:color] panel next to a [bg:image] panel, both with zero captured text, at a position where other pages in the same template family show real heading/paragraph text in an equivalent slot.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted extraction rather than concluding the zone is a pure decorative background. Rejected alternative: treating it as a plain full-width-image-behind-text section per the generic rule, since no text was captured to overlay.
proposed_rules.rationale: The minWidth capture likely collapsed responsive text that would normally accompany the image panel, matching the underrendered-list-zone pattern but for a split-image feature row rather than a card grid.

proposed_rules.trigger: An empty 252px-tall zone with no text or children, appearing as the last content node before the global footer on a solution page.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude from block inventory as a decorative spacer/divider.
proposed_rules.rationale: Exact 252px height recurs identically on multiple solution pages (C243, C247), consistent with a fixed site-wide spacer element rather than lost content.

notes: Standard solution-3 template: hero, trust badges, one under-rendered split-image panel, alternating feature callouts, one cards grid, resource cards, FAQ accordion, trailing spacer, global chrome.
